content: Tuberoinfundibular peptide of 39 residues (TIP39) is a protein encoded by the PTH2 gene in humans. TIP39 is structurally and functionally related to parathyroid hormone (PTH) and parathyroid hormone-related protein (PTHRP). It acts as a ligand for the parathyroid hormone receptor-2 (PTHR2). Detailed three-dimensional molecular studies have elucidated the interaction between TIP39 and the PTH2 receptor. These studies have identified specific amino acid residues, including tyrosine at position 318 (Tyr-318) within transmembrane helix 5, as critical for the high-affinity binding of TIP39 to the receptor.
